description: The question that isn't settled is implementation — and this is where I hear from Nevadans of every stripe. Not "should we have ID," but "can I actually get one," "what will it cost me," and "what happens if something goes wrong at the polls." Those aren't partisan questions. They're the questions any parent, retiree, small business owner, or working Nevadan would ask about a rule that affects their vote.
